Labelled by hand: 1 for a kicker announcing a live broadcast of an event (the page is a stream, not a report), 0 otherwise. A recorded clip ("WATCH") and a live blog ("Live updates") report what happened and are 0. Case-folded duplicates removed (the similarity model is uncased). Read by action_center._broadcast_threshold.
